comments.text:
@4kfilmsbyadnan Thank you so much for sharing this magnificent journey through Japan! From Mount Fuji, Kyoto and Hokkaido to Ishigaki Island and the dramatic cliffs of Hotokegaura, I especially enjoyed how you brought together both Japan’s iconic landmarks and its lesser-known natural treasures in beautiful 4K. As someone living in Japan, it is wonderful to rediscover the beauty of my own country through your perspective.

Hello from Tokyo! A typhoon and a linear rainband passed close to Tokyo and have finally moved west, but the torrential rainfall has caused serious flooding in many places. And it seems another typhoon may already be approaching. Greetings from a Tokyo drone YouTuber in a city that seems to be facing one natural disaster after another.
